Taking your pet to the emergency vet is never an easy or joyful thing to do. Usually it’s coupled with stress and anxiety, and it can bring out the worst in people as they navigate stressful situations and the unknown wellbeing of their beloved pet(s). I found myself in the unlucky position of having to take not one, but two, pets to the emergency event this weekend. And I am so glad IAC Urgent Vets is where I went for their care.

Everyone who works there was patient, calm and caring. They made me feel heard and took time to explain every step of the way with clarity and warmth. Dr. Ash and Dr. Small are two truly incredible people - their patience and warm bedside manner helped me navigate sadness and uncertainty to get my two cats taken care of and returned home. All of the helpers - the VAs, the receptionists - were equally patient and warm during my visits (I was there 4 times over 72 hours). I joked on my way out that I hope I never see any of them again, but if I find myself in a situation to need emergency care for my pets again, I won’t hesitate to go to IAC Urgent Vets.

I live on a fixed income, and they helped me tremendously with my dog. My dog isn’t just a pet—he’s my child. I honestly don’t know what I would have done if I had lost him simply because I couldn’t afford the treatment he needed. I would have been devastated.

I’m so thankful that IAC Urgent Vets was there when I needed them. They treated my dog with care and compassion while also understanding my financial situation. I truly appreciate everything you guys did for me and my baby. IAC Urgent Vets, I love you guys! ❤️

Inconsiderate and unprofessional is the nicest thing i can say about this hospital. My husband and i came in on a Monday because our elder dog wasn't doing well. We spent almost all day there while the receptionist played tiktoks and loud music on her phone. The times they kept telling us for everything kept going up and no one really seemed to care about our dog. We decided to take her home after spending thousands of dollars on tests with almost no answers. She took a turn for the worst that night and we ended up putting her down the next day (Tuesday) we let the hospital staff know our decision since she had a follow up appointment on Wednesday so they wouldn't expect her. My husband received a call two days later on friday asking if we wanted to review our dogs test results (that we already reviewed with the vet) and asked how she was doing as if we didn't tell them she had passed two days prior. They just don't care in this office and i would NOT trust them with your pets.
Iac urgent vets one of the best vet clinics I’ve been to I have no complaints

Not sure what game they're playing.  We wouldn't be here if it wasn't for my baby girl being so severely itchy that she can't even sleep because of itchiness. Jeesh waiting 3 hours. I’m incredibly grateful to the entire team at IAC Urgent Vets for taking such wonderful care of my cat. She was diagnosed with pyometra (PYO), and the staff acted quickly, professionally, and compassionately to give her the treatment she needed.

Thanks to their expertise and dedication, my cat is now healthy and doing so much better. I can’t thank the veterinarians and staff enough for helping save her and giving our family peace of mind during such a frightening time.

I highly recommend IAC Urgent Vets to anyone looking for caring, knowledgeable, and compassionate veterinary care. Thank you for everything you did for my cat! ❤️🐾
